title: The Year the Internet Went Crazy
narrative: NFTs sell for millions. Facebook becomes Meta. Dogecoin goes to the moon. The chip shortage delays everything. Apple's M1 chips prove ARM is the future. Web3 promises a decentralized internet. Clubhouse peaks then crashes. The metaverse becomes a punchline before it even exists.
